assumptions.assumption: Requirement R2 is assumed to be a separate class not related to Node, Element, or Text.

verifier_problems_last.issue: Requirement R2 (An attribute node) is not represented in the model.
verifier_problems_last.fix: Add a class for attribute node.

verifier_problems_last.issue: Requirement R6 (A Node of an XML file may have one parent which is an Element of the XML file) is not fully represented. The current model only shows an association but does not specify the cardinality or the direction of the parent-child relationship.
verifier_problems_last.fix: Define the parent-child relationship with the correct cardinality and direction.

verifier_problems_last.issue: Requirement R7 (An Element of an XML file can have many children Nodes) is not fully represented. The current model only shows an association but does not specify the cardinality or the direction of the child relationship.
verifier_problems_last.fix: Define the child relationship with the correct cardinality and direction.
